data.long_meaning: In Latin, Amparo means 'to protect' or 'to defend'. In Christian tradition, it is a name given to saints and babies who are believed to offer protection and support. The name Amparo carries the meaning “Protector or Defender” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Amparo usually hope their child will grow to embody protector or defender and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amparo total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
